name: Glass Panel

semanticTypeCandidates.evidence: The three translucent columns and album card of the reference; every product surface
Model menu, context menus, right-side inspector panels

representativeVariants.whySelected: Outermost 28px rounded floating window over ambient wallpaper
Sidebar pane separated by a hairline, not a bordered card
Opaque-ish content card (album art card): near-solid white in dark, soft shadow
Floating menu/popover panel: densest, smallest radius, deepest blur for legibility

structurePatterns: The glass six-pack: translucent fill + hairline border + inset top highlight + backdrop blur/saturate + ambient shadow + continuous corner
Blur lives on a ::before stacking layer so content updates don't repaint the filter (performance rule)
Inactive windows drop saturate to ~120% and reduce fill alpha by 0.03
Nested glass: only ONE of any two nested panels carries a blur; the inner one uses a translucent fill alone

usageHints.do: Layer at most 3 blur surfaces along any sightline; reuse blur tiers window/popover/deep
usageHints.avoid: Never put borders AND heavy shadows AND outlines on the same panel; pick border+shadow only

doNotInvent: No colorful gradient fills inside panels
unknowns: Wallpaper blob asset set delivered with theme package
keyInsightSeed: Depth comes from blur tiers and one blurred layer per nesting level — not from borders.
